files.method: Downloaded four original building B3DM tiles and one road B3DM tile; parsed with py3dtiles12.1.1/pygltflib1.16.5; extracted original embedded WebP bytes and decoded dimensions with Pillow. Rendered building LOD counts come from binary _lod properties.
